_comment: REDACTED EXAMPLE of the DISCOUNT_CONFIG secret. The REAL values (codes + pricing) live only in the Cloudflare secret and in a gitignored offers.config.json — never in this public repo. Copy this to offers.config.json, fill in real values, then: wrangler secret put DISCOUNT_CONFIG < offers.config.json
warnings: You must copy & paste this code at checkout for each student to enjoy the discount.
validity: Codes are valid for 30 days and cannot be combined with any other offers.
